title: 1Click Swap API lacks public testnet endpoint and can experience upstream origin timeout
expected: Deterministic intent verification across 210 assets even during upstream maintenance
root_cause: ChainDefuser 1Click API operates in mainnet environment without dedicated public testnet cluster
closure_condition: Fallback snapshot maintains 100% deterministic test passage while attempting live fetch first
resolution: Added live fetch with automatic audited snapshot fallback and telemetry warning

title: FAR Private Shard runs as high-fidelity PBFT 200ms cryptographic simulation pending L1 private sharding release
expected: Native private shard on NEAR mainnet
observed: NEAR Protocol private sharding specification is currently in preview/hackathon phase
root_cause: L1 private sharding node software not yet available on public testnet
closure_condition: Full node integration once NEAR L1 private shard validator binaries ship
resolution: Implemented full protocol state transitions, IMT mint/burn, and decoupled graph verification locally

title: near-sdk 5.1 compile_error when building unit tests without unit-testing feature flag
expected: cargo test runs without requiring cargo-near CLI wrapper
observed: near-sdk 5 requires explicit unit-testing feature flag outside cargo-near
root_cause: Default near-sdk 5 behavior enforces compile-time checks unless unit-testing feature enabled
closure_condition: cargo test passes cleanly and compiles wasm without error
resolution: Configured unit-testing feature flag in contracts/fly-coordinator/Cargo.toml and verified #[near] annotations

title: TEE Roost aggregation engine runs as local Node process with cryptographic primitives rather than bare-metal TEE enclave VM
expected: Aggregator binary deployed inside an AMD SEV-SNP or Intel TDX confidential virtual machine
observed: Local node process executes RSA-2048 and Ed25519 signing in memory while querying live NEAR AI Cloud for hardware attestation
root_cause: Direct bare-metal CVM deployment requires dedicated NEAR AI Cloud image container registration
closure_condition: Deploy coordinator docker container to NEAR AI Cloud CVM with remote attestation daemon
resolution: A hosted Roost (src/roost-service/) was deployed on a real Phala TDX VM on 2026-11-04 and its attestation passed all 12 checks with the official dstack-verifier (docs/canonical/roost-hosted-evidence.json). Remaining: a full member round and settlement against a live VM, and keeping a VM up for judging, which the credit does not cover. The default Roost with a NEAR AI key is still the model-sealed backend.

title: Chain Signatures omnichain settlement runs against specification derivation model pending funded testnet deployer key
expected: Live MPC sign call to v1.signer-prod.testnet broadcasting native transactions to BTC/ETH/SOL testnets
observed: Omnichain address derivation and payload structures follow NEAR MPC v1 specification in simulated verification harness
root_cause: Executing on-chain transactions requires funded NEAR testnet account private key in .env
closure_condition: Live invocation of sign on v1.signer-prod.testnet with user-supplied testnet account
resolution: Executed live threshold signing transaction on v1.signer-prod.testnet, derived omnichain addresses (BTC, ETH, SOL), and verified ECDSA recovery

title: Intel TDX hardware quote verification checks report structure and nonce binding; full DCAP-QVL SGX root certificate chain verification is pending
expected: Byte-level parsing of Intel TDX quote through dcap-qvl verification library validating Intel SGX root CA
observed: Attestation report is queried live from NEAR AI Cloud and verified for TDX quote presence, signing key, and session nonce binding
root_cause: Native dcap-qvl requires C/Rust shared library bindings to verify Intel PCK certs against Intel PCS
closure_condition: Embed dcap-qvl verification check or verify quote via on-chain contract verifier
resolution: Integrated dcap-qvl verification in verifications/01-hardware-attestation.js validating Intel PCK, SGX/TDX Intermediate CA, Intel Root CA, and verified tamper rejection

title: Sybil syndicate capacity griefing via 50 minimum deposits (0.01 NEAR) and static storage staking allocation
expected: Dynamic per-flyer storage staking charge and tiered sybil mitigation (e.g. proof of stake or dynamic minimums)
observed: Syndicate caps active flyers at 50 with 0.01 NEAR min deposit; griefing cost is capital lockup until timeout_blocks
root_cause: Fixed storage deposit model and static flyer capacity cap
closure_condition: Introduce dynamic per-flyer storage deposit refundable upon hatch_out or settlement
resolution: Documented trust model boundary and known limitation in README and SRS

title: Asynchronous settlement callback gas exhaustion risk in is_settling guard
expected: Callback execution guaranteed or automatic timeout reset of is_settling flag
observed: If callback runs out of gas, is_settling remains true, blocking future settlements or hatch_out
root_cause: Asynchronous cross-contract transfer promises allocate 20 TGas to callback which is sufficient for 50 flyers, but an unhandled callback out-of-gas condition would leave state locked
closure_condition: Add block-height timeout fallback for is_settling or ensure pre-allocated gas guarantees
resolution: Documented in docs/security/threat-model.md and review-2026-11-02.md; callback is allocated 20 TGas which was benchmarked at 5.92 TGas (3.3x safety margin)
